quote_en: Opaque citation identifiers must be verified before display. API-014 does not automatically authorize source URL access through API-054.

The repeated source wording about validating GET requests “before allocating a long-running operation” does not sufficiently establish that ordinary reads create jobs. A read-failure-to-async conversion contract **Needs confirmation**; implementations must not fabricate a successful read or an undocumented job response.
The source does not settle whether publication is automatic following API-017 or separately triggered.

This specification defines data requirements for OrionDesk AI **OD-AI-DDS-001, R1.0 / revision 1.3**. It preserves identifiers from [01_screen_functions.md](01_screen_functions.md) and [02_api.md](02_api.md).
The source does not confirm a global singleton scheduler or one-job-at-a-time rule. A lock/lease design must be recorded before implementation rather than inferred from the required invariants.
The source does not supply the full input-to-outcome decision matrix, overlapping-rule precedence or default outcome. These must be approved before implementing policy evaluation.
Ordinary GET failures must not silently become undocumented asynchronous jobs or emit mutation events. The repeated interface wording does not resolve such a read-conversion contract.
**Source** means `1794310747-OrionDesk_AI_Detailed_Design_Specification.pdf`. All page references are original PDF page numbers.
**FLOW-R-002 — Confirmed:** Explicit dependencies, durable checkpoints and safe duplicate processing determine execution eligibility. The source does not establish a global singleton scheduler.
Repeated statements, assumptions, illustrative values and later-generated proposals do not establish approval. No decision owner, deadline or approval date is supplied for the open items.
